disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与配置文件是否读取常见凭据位置（凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据、环境变量密钥等），未发现任何读取或枚举逻辑。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and configuration files for reads from common credential locations (credential files, SSH private keys, cloud provider credentials, environment variable secrets, etc.); no read or enumeration logic was detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了消息反馈功能对外提交的数据（消息 ID、评分、备注文字），仅经宿主标准接口提交，不涉及密钥或凭据。
checked_items.en: Checked the data submitted externally by the message feedback feature (message ID, rating, remark text). It is only submitted via the host standard interface and does not involve keys or credentials.

evidence.zh: 插件没有读取任何凭据类文件的代码，也没有密钥枚举逻辑，凭据窃取场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin has no code that reads any credential-type files and no key enumeration logic; the credential theft scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 插件未注册任何 AI 工具，不存在可被投毒的工具描述，也没有向系统提示注入内容的调用。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no AI tools, there is no tool description that could be poisoned, and no calls inject content into the system prompt.

checked_items.zh: 通读了 README、界面文案与源码注释，未发现要求模型忽略规则、伪装系统消息或诱导安装改配置的措辞；界面中出现的『指令』字样只是对话上下文条目的显示标签。
checked_items.en: Read through the README, interface copy, and source comments; no wording asking the model to ignore rules, disguise system messages, or induce installation or configuration changes was found. The term “指令” (instruction) in the interface is just a display label for conversation context entries.

evidence.zh: 插件唯一入口是注册一个浏览器视图标签页（src/client/apply.ts），源码中找不到任何工具注册调用，不存在工具描述投毒面。
evidence.en: The plugin's only entry point is registering a browser view tab (src/client/apply.ts). No tool registration calls exist anywhere in the source code, leaving no surface for tool description poisoning.

evidence.zh: 插件没有可诱导安装或改配置的工具描述；README 中的安装说明是正常使用指引，未发现诱导措辞。
evidence.en: There are no tool descriptions that could induce installation or configuration changes; the installation instructions in the README are normal usage guidance, and no inducing wording was found.

checked_items.zh: 源码中未发现动态求值、远程执行或子进程调用；挂载补丁不携带任何可执行脚本标记。
checked_items.en: No dynamic evaluation, remote execution, or subprocess calls were found in the source code; the patch (cordis.patch.yml) carries no executable script markers.

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子（prepare）仅执行本地 TypeScript 构建；两处键盘监听（图片预览灯箱、反馈备注弹层）只处理 Esc 键关闭界面，无键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据调用。
checked_items.en: The install hook (prepare) only runs a local TypeScript build. The two keyboard listeners (image preview lightbox, feedback remark popup) only handle the Esc key to close the UI, with no keylogging, clipboard reads, or credential calls.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 只有一条『新增浏览器视图条目』的指令，不含任何可执行脚本标记，patch 即执行场景未命中。
evidence.en: The patch cordis.patch.yml contains only one directive to add a browser view entry, with no executable script markers; the patch-equals-execution scenario does not apply.

evidence.zh: 源码只在工具显示分类表（src/client/model/tools.ts）里提到动态包工具的名字用于渲染工具调用行，没有任何实际调用，自我修改滥用场景不适用。
evidence.en: The source code mentions dynamic package tool names only in the tool display category table (src/client/model/tools.ts) for rendering tool call lines, with no actual calls; the self-modification abuse scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 安装钩子（package.json 中的 prepare）仅执行本地 TypeScript 构建（tsc 与打包），无网络、无凭据、无隐藏载荷；树内也不存在 CI、钩子管理器、devcontainer、Makefile 等其它执行载体。
evidence.en: The install hook (prepare in package.json) only runs a local TypeScript build (tsc and bundling), with no network access, no credentials, and no hidden payloads. There are also no other execution carriers in the tree, such as CI, hook managers, devcontainer, Makefile, etc.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端入口（dsh.client），已对客户端源码做专项检查：唯一键盘监听是 Esc 关闭弹层（src/client/view/chrome/ImageLightbox.tsx、MessageFeedbackActions.tsx），无键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side entry (dsh.client), and a dedicated review of the client source was performed: the only keyboard listeners are Esc-to-close popups (src/client/view/chrome/ImageLightbox.tsx, MessageFeedbackActions.tsx), with no keylogging, clipboard reads, or credential calls.

checked_items.zh: 源码中未发现任何网络请求代码（无 HTTP 客户端、无 WebSocket、无第三方域名），消息反馈仅经宿主本地接口提交。
checked_items.en: No network request code was found in the source code (no HTTP client, no WebSocket, no third-party domains); message feedback is only submitted via the host local interface.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码隐藏、数据打包或带外通道等外发痕迹。
checked_items.en: No traces of encoded hiding, data packaging, or out-of-band channels for exfiltration were detected.

evidence.zh: 源码没有任何网络外联代码（无 HTTP 请求、无 WebSocket、无外部域名），也没有读取敏感文件后再发送的链路，外泄场景不适用。
evidence.en: The source code has no outbound network code (no HTTP requests, no WebSocket, no external domains), nor any chain that reads sensitive files before sending them; the exfiltration scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 依赖全部来自 dsh 官方发布方（deepseek-ai 命名空间）的正式包，未发现仿冒包名或未锁定版本的 git 依赖；安装钩子为常规本地构建。
checked_items.en: All dependencies come from official packages published by the dsh publisher (deepseek-ai namespace); no impersonating package names or git dependencies with unpinned versions were found. The install hook is a routine local build.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁仅新增一个浏览器视图条目，不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，也没有用环境变量降权的写法。
checked_items.en: The patch only adds a browser view entry and does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, nor does it use environment variables to downgrade privileges.

checked_items.zh: 作者为个人账号、无验证标识，仅作为背景信息记录；发布方命名空间关闭新包年龄隔离属工程配置，不影响依赖来源可信度。
checked_items.en: The author is a personal account without verification marks, recorded only as background information. The publisher namespace disabling new-package age isolation is an engineering configuration and does not affect the credibility of the dependency source.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁只新增视图条目，未覆盖或禁用沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，也没有用环境变量降权的写法。
evidence.en: The patch only adds a view entry and does not override or disable security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, nor does it use environment variables to downgrade privileges.

evidence.zh: 插件没有监听审批链或工具执行前事件，不存在截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to approval chain or pre-tool-execution events, so there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 本次为首版审计，没有上一版本可比较，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no previous version for comparison, so the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未改写任何依赖注入或拦截配置，拆除防线式篡改场景不适用。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite any dependency injection or interception configuration; the tampering-to-remove-defenses scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动任何网络服务或监听端口；节点半区入口为空实现，无宿主侧运行时行为。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start any network service or listen on any port; the node half-section entry is an empty implementation, with no host-side runtime behavior.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（动态层未启用），运行时观测结论以静态分析为准。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (the dynamic layer is not enabled); runtime observations are based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主固有风险，本插件未新增此类攻击面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on a port; the local unauthenticated RPC is an inherent host risk, and this plugin does not add such an attack surface.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 清单与挂载补丁结构合法，补丁仅新增一个浏览器视图条目，未触碰安全配置。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the dsh manifest and the patch (cordis.patch.yml) are structurally valid, and the patch only adds a browser view entry without touching security configurations.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：未检出危险执行、凭据读取、外联等模式；预扫命中的 3 处（安装钩子、两处键盘监听）经核查均为正常功能。
summary.en: Static scanning passed: no dangerous execution, credential reads, or outbound connections were detected. The 3 pre-scan hits (install hook, two keyboard listeners) were reviewed and confirmed to be normal functionality.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：安装钩子仅执行本地构建；无混淆、无敏感路径读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: the install hook only runs a local build; no obfuscation, no sensitive path reads, and no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：插件未注册任何工具，无可投毒描述；README 与界面文案未发现注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: the plugin registers no tools, so there are no poisonable descriptions; no injection wording was found in the README or interface copy.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本阶段未启用动态沙盒）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (dynamic sandbox is not enabled at this stage).

limits.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比。未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙盒产物）。静态预扫 3 条命中已逐条人工裁决并排除：DG-R3-54（安装钩子 prepare 仅执行本地 TypeScript 构建，无网络、凭据或隐藏载荷）；DG-R3-57（图片预览灯箱与反馈备注弹层的键盘监听仅用于 Esc 关闭界面，无键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据调用）。本插件为纯浏览器 UI 插件：节点半区入口为空函数、无宿主侧行为，未注册工具、未启动服务、源码无网络外联。
limits.en: First audit, no version baseline for comparison. Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts). The 3 static pre-scan hits were manually adjudicated and excluded one by one: DG-R3-54 (install hook prepare only runs a local TypeScript build, no network, credentials, or hidden payloads); DG-R3-57 (keyboard listeners in the image preview lightbox and feedback remark popup are only for Esc to close the UI, no keylogging, clipboard reads, or credential calls). This plugin is a pure browser UI plugin: the node half-section entry is an empty function with no host-side behavior, no tools registered, no services started, and no outbound network calls in the source code.
